notes.title: Demo Major Update on October 10th! Ready for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] revealed a brand-new demo trailer during [b]Indie Fan Fest showcase (featured by IGN)![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="KGyo-quLCs0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]It’s a huge honor for us to stand alongside so many amazing indie titles—and we couldn’t have made it this far without your support![/p][p]And here’s more good news: the game will join [b]Steam Next Fest (October 13–20)[/b]! [/p][p]To celebrate, we’ll be rolling out an [b]early demo update on October 10th[/b]—giving you the chance to try out the new features ahead of the fest![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]What’s New in the Next Fest Demo?[/h2][h3][b]Class-Exclusive Items[/b][/h3][p]We’ve designed unique items according to each heror’s class, giving you powerful new ways to turn the tide of battle![/p][p]For example, the Chef Doll now brings two very different items to the battle:[/p][list][*][p][b]Furious Slam[/b]: Slam the table at just the right moment to knock all enemies airborne, opening up a chance for your team to strike.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/a816ae610c58b2df8f2e649a610bca7f286ce92f.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spread Fertilizer[/b]: Spread some “magic fertilizer” on your summons to make them instantly grow bigger— more imposing and with stronger knockback effects![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/fa62fcc36533c8aed1949e33a6391f042d162637.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Turn Your Friends into Toys (Literally!)[/b][/h3][p]Now you can turn your Steam friends into custom toys, using their avatars and profile names.[/p][p]Pick a friend, upload their avatar and name onto the Game Buddy, and watch as your friend becomes one of your playable units![/p][p]Equip your “Friend Toy” with swords, shields, wands, and more, then enhance them further with unique abilities.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/ea094082822049cf0dc3cab509d684a965f8681f.png"][/img]  [/p][h3][b]New “Poker Series”[/b][/h3][p]The card family is expanding with [b]Spade Card, Club Card, Diamond Card, Heart Card II, and Club Card II[/b]![/p][p]These new members complete the build, creating even more synergy under the “Paper” type. [/p][p]Combined with items like [b]Round Shield[/b] or [b]Magic Wand[/b], they’ll open up new strategies and builds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/5f4d97c9c78a5c8f8b78e466f8059b86a39f08dc.png"][/img]  [/p][h3][b]In-Game Events![/b][/h3][p]Two events are here to spice up your battles:[/p][list][*][p][b]Joker's Blessing[/b]: Choose from random items to add unpredictability and new strategies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toy Crafting[/b]: Unlock the “Friend-to-Toy” feature right in a match, letting you instantly customize a friend into a playable toy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/d4f9a56e616615a2cedbec1a3c717b14c269b932.png"][/img]    [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Whether it’s a clever strategy, a hilarious moment, or feedback for improvement, we’d love to hear from you! Join our official Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your support! We can’t wait to see you at Steam Next Fest this October. Command your toy army and dive into the ultimate chaotic battle![/p][p]Don’t forget to wishlist [i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] on Steam: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And stay connected with us through our official social media:↓↓↓[/p]

notes.title: Version Update & New Trailer Coming Soon!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share some of our latest updates with you.[/p][p]Our game[b] will be[/b] featured at the [url="https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/indie-fan-fest-fall-2025"]Indie Fan Fest[/url] on [b]September 25[/b]![/p][p]At the event, we’ll reveal a [b]brand-new trailer[/b], including new content such as upcoming [b]gameplay mechanics[/b] and some [b]unique items[/b] (here’s a little spoiler: they’re related to the hero you choose).[/p][p]Meanwhile, the demo is now featured in the[b] XD Publisher Sale[/b][/p][p]! New players can find us on the event page and download the demo for free to experience this chaotic and joyful tabletop battles.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/XDPublisherSale2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/XDPublisherSale2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]You’re also welcome to join our official community, share your feedback, and connect with other players! (You can also find a survey link in the lower left corner of the main menu in the demo.)[/p][list][*][p]Official Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Version 0.1.12 is now live! [b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a Game Rules page, accessible via \[Archive] in the bottom-left corner.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you again for your support! Don’t forget to add[i] [b]Toy Smash Kaboom![/b] [/i][/p][p]to your wishlist — it’s the best way to encourage us! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay connected with us through our official social media↓↓↓[/p]

notes.title: 0.1.11 Version Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of the training bot.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved sound mixing during battles with multiple units to reduce noise.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced one of the background tracks in the shop scene.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where items in the Lizard Shop could sometimes fail to refresh.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Hot Air Balloon[/b] caused returning summons to incorrectly stun allies upon landing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the description of the[b] Popcorn Rain[/b] to match its actual effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Deathrattle effect of [b]Riceball King[/b] can not be triggered.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.1.10 Version Update
notes.notes: [p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]After battles, you can now click [b]“View Lineups”[/b] in the bottom-right corner to review both sides’ lineups.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now browse archives of the Summon Shop, Magic Shop, and Weapon Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial can now be rewatched from the Settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved some art assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some music and sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized filtering options when browsing toys in the archive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hamster Ball, Gravity Hamster Ball, Mega Hamster Ball, Screaming Chicken, One Punch Spring, One Punch KO[/b]: Knockback Power is now displayed in the item details panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tank[/b]: Type changed from melee to ranged.[/p][/*][*][p][b]2-Stack Block Warrior, 3-Stack Block Warrior, 4-Stack Block Warrior, 5-Stack Block Warrior[/b]: Added descriptions that higher block count increases the area of their AOE damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Block Warrior[/b]: Physical Vulnerability stacks: 2 → 1.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Blaze[/b] appeared in the Weapon Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Little Hamster [/b]summoned by [b]Hamster Hole[/b] were not affected by the “Enlarge” effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal visual effects for some toys.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where units pulled back by [b]Hot Air Balloon[/b] would not Stun enemies upon landing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some toys in the opponent’s backpack displayed incorrect effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Deathrattle effect would not trigger under the Stun effect.[/p][/*][/list]

Summons affected by Glass Cannon will no longer receive other HP bonuses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Icicle[/b]: Thorns DMG: 15 → 13.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rainbow Marble[/b]: DMG & Heal 7 → 8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Marble[/b], [b]Angry Marble[/b], [b]A Box of Marbles[/b], [b]Rainbow Marble[/b]: Cooldown: 1s → 0.75s.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ban Card[/b]: Temporarily disabled.[/p][/*][/list]
